input.question: What is the population of Bennington Township?

documents.text: ( 0.1 km 2 ) Elevation [ 1 ] 1,181 ft ( 360 m ) Population ( 2010 ) • Total 3,102 • Density 122.6/sq mi ( 47.4/km 2 ) Time zone UTC-5 ( Eastern ( EST ) ) • Summer ( DST ) UTC-4 ( EDT ) FIPS code 39-05508 [ 2 ] GNIS feature ID 1086697 [ 1 ] Bennington Township is one of the sixteen townships of Morrow County , Ohio , United States .
